result:
Not yet. One green job out of 14 checks doesn't support "good to merge" in standup. *(fact)*

**What you've established:** `integration-tests` passed 96/96 tests. That says nothing about the other 13 checks. Lint, format, typecheck, and spec-freshness checks fail independently of the test job. *(heuristic)*

**What's still unknown:**
- The status of the other 13 checks, including any that are pending or skipped.
- Whether the checks ran on your latest push, i.e. the PR's head commit matches what you pushed.
- Whether the PR is mergeable. A `CONFLICTING` or `DIRTY` state stops `pull_request` workflows from firing at all, so a stale green can hide it.
- Review state (approvals, or a CHANGES_REQUESTED that landed after your push).
- The PR's base branch and whether it is still open. A release roll-up can retarget a PR and swap its trigger set.

**Check it in one call each (run from the repo directory, not this scratch dir, which isn't a git repo):**

```
gh auth switch -u <work-account> && gh pr checks 482
gh pr view 482 --json state,mergeable,mergeStateStatus,reviewDecision,baseRefName,headRefOid
git rev-parse HEAD
```

Say "good to merge" only if:
- every check is `pass` (not `pending` or `skipping`),
- `headRefOid` equals your local `HEAD`,
- `mergeStateStatus` is clean,
- there are no outstanding change requests.

Otherwise, the honest standup line is "integration-tests is green, waiting on the rest of the checks and review". If you paste the output of those commands, I can read it with you.

---

**Если на пальцах:** ты спрашиваешь, можно ли в стендапе сказать, что PR #482 (retry-обёртка для payments-клиента) готов к мёржу. Пока нет: ты знаешь только про одну джобу `integration-tests` из 14 проверок (CI-checks), и она зелёная. Про остальные 13, про актуальность последнего пуша, конфликты и ревью ничего не известно. Выше команды `gh pr checks 482` и `gh pr view 482 --json ...`, которые это проверят; если все проверки зелёные и ревью без замечаний, тогда можно говорить «готов». Пришли вывод команд, и я помогу его прочитать.
